configured_model: gpt-6-astra (coordinator configured; exact serving variant not independently exposed)
native_task: No UI/audio output; execute actual native boundaries per ADR0005.
criteria: Reproducibly download, verify official SHA256, build and install pinned PostgreSQL 18.6 into owned project artifacts without global packages or shell/home changes.

Provide bounded setup/start/status/stop commands for an owned durable development cluster outside artifacts; deny TCP listening, protect socket/data permissions, and never replace existing data or stop an unrelated process.

Use real psql transactions to verify version, rollback/commit, restart persistence, parameter-safe diagnostic output and Pg readiness; preserve fsync/full_page_writes/synchronous_commit and explicit configured connection/process limits.

Retain source/runtime/build/configuration/ownership hashes, exact commands, error outcomes, startup and shutdown evidence and devlog; do not claim G05 persistence/schema/tenant/recovery/media or production readiness is complete.
procedures: Verify pinned archive, official checksum and exact reused build identity, installation provenance, source edit scope.
Run actual lifecycle/permissions/TCP checks, malformed/dead/foreign/stale PID/socket/symlink/orphan and timeout boundaries only in evaluator-owned fixture.
Run real rollback, commit, readiness/settings checks and restart persistence.
Retain all identities, commands/outcomes and ownership protections; inspect setup-only scope and append devlog.
